_comment: Violence on a town's street map (systems/streetCrime.js, ui/innerMapReactions.js): who sees it, how they react on the spot, what they remember, and what they say afterwards. Placeholders in lines: {victim} the victim's name, {kin} how the speaker names the victim ('my brother Brom', 'Brom'), {player} the player's name, {town} where it happened, {deed} 'killed' / 'beat'.

sight._comment: Chebyshev tiles from the victim. Indoors everyone in the building sees it. Guards within hearRadius who did not see it come running all the same.

disposition._comment: Change to a witness's opinion of the player (0-100, 50 neutral). Kin and friends are also hit by NpcDisposition.onNpcHarmed; these are on top.

refuse._comment: A witness below talkBelow will not chat (amends or leave only). Traders who saw it refuse to deal below tradeBelow.

hearsay._comment: Townsfolk who did not see it hear of it through the town's talk: at the scene share = base + perDay * days since (capped at 1); in towns the rumour has reached, elsewhereShare. mentionAgain: chance they bring it up again once already told.

heat._comment: Share of the crime's underworld heat when no one saw it (a body is still found).

arrest._comment: The watch: days in the cell on top of the heat-based sentence, a fine for a beating (scaled by town size, never less than the bounty owed here), the odds of running for it, and how long the guards remember an unanswered crime in their town.

anger: Guards! A killing in the street!
Touch {kin} again and I'll kill you!
I'll have your blood for this!
Halt! In the name of the crown!

fear: *backs away* I saw what you did to {victim}. Please... I don't want any trouble.
*won't meet your eyes* You're the one who set upon {victim}. Just... leave me be.
anger: I saw you beat {victim} in the street like a dog. What sort of creature are you?
You've a nerve, talking to me after what you did to {victim}.
old: I've not forgotten what you did to {victim}.
You're the one who beat {victim}. People here remember.

fear: *trembling* I saw you kill {victim}. Please, I won't say anything, just don't hurt me.
*goes pale* Stay back! I saw what you did to {victim}!
anger: Murderer. I watched {victim} die at your hands, and you dare speak to me?
{victim}'s blood isn't even dry and here you are, bold as brass. Get away from me.
old: I still see {victim} lying there when I close my eyes. You did that.
You're the one who killed {victim}. I'll never forget your face.

fear: *flinches* Not again, please! I'm still black and blue from the last time.
*shields their face* Stay away from me! Haven't you hurt me enough?
anger: You've got some gall. My ribs still ache from your beating.
Come to finish the job? I'll not go down so easy this time.
old: I remember you. You beat me in the street, and for nothing.
The bruises have faded. What you did hasn't.

fear: *steps between you and the door* You hurt {kin}. Please, just go.
{kin} still can't sleep for what you did. Leave us alone.
anger: You beat {kin} half to death. Give me one reason not to return the favour.
Lay a finger on {kin} again and it'll be the last thing you do.
old: I haven't forgotten what you did to {kin}.
Our family remembers you. You beat {kin}.

fear: *sobbing* You killed {kin}. Why? Why would you do that?
*voice breaking* {kin} is dead because of you. Go away. Please, just go away.
anger: *glares with red eyes* You killed {kin}. I'll see you hang, if it's the last thing I do.
You murdered {kin} in the street. Get out of my sight before I do something.
old: {kin}'s grave is still fresh in my heart. You put it there.
There's not a day I don't curse your name for {kin}.

fear: {victim} is my friend. I saw what you did. Please, just leave.
anger: {victim} is my friend, and you beat them in the street. I'll not forget it.
old: You're the one who hurt {victim}. Don't expect a kind word from me.

fear: *hushed* {victim} was my friend. And you... you just killed them.
anger: {victim} was my friend. You murdered them, and I'll make sure everyone knows it.
old: I lost a friend in {victim} because of you. Don't think I've forgotten.

anger: You're the one who beat {victim} in the street. You'll answer for that.
Assaulting the townsfolk in plain sight? You're coming with me.
old: I've had my eye on you since you beat {victim}. Step carefully.

anger: {victim}'s killer, walking up to the watch? In the crown's name, you're under arrest.
I saw you cut down {victim}. Hands where I can see them.
old: We've not forgotten {victim}. Neither has the crown.

here: Did you hear? Someone set upon {victim} in the street. A stranger, they say... about your build, now I look at you.
*eyes you warily* Folk say {victim} took a beating from some outsider. You wouldn't know anything about that?
elsewhere: I heard tell of a brawler in {town} who beat some poor soul senseless. Was that you?
There's talk of trouble in {town}. Someone matching your look, so they say.

here: *lowers voice* They say {victim} was killed in the street, and the killer still walks about. You... you look like the one they describe.
*edges away* Word is {victim} was murdered. Folk are saying it was a stranger. Someone like you.
elsewhere: There's a story out of {town}: a stranger killed {victim} in the street. They say the killer looked a lot like you.
*studies your face* You've been to {town}? There was a killing there. I hope it wasn't you they meant.

refuseTrade.assault: {name} won't trade with someone who beats people in the street.
refuseTrade.murder: {name} saw you kill {victim} and will have nothing to do with you.

lines.refuseTalk: They want nothing to do with you.

text.assault: {guard} plants himself in your path, hand on his sword. "You beat {victim} in the street, in front of half the town. You can pay the fine, or you can see the inside of a cell."
text.murder: {guard} blocks your way, blade half drawn. "{victim} lies dead and the whole street saw who did it. You're coming with me."

outcomes.submit: You give yourself up. The watch takes you to the cells: {days} days.
outcomes.fine: You count {fine} gold into the guard's hand. He writes it in his book and lets you go, with a warning.
outcomes.escaped: You dodge past {guard} and lose him in the crowd. The watch will be looking for you.
outcomes.caught: You break and run, but {guard} is faster. They drag you to the cells: {days} days.
outcomes.resist: You square up to {guard}. Resisting the watch will not help your name.
